LESSON: READING 6.2.1 READING FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Reading 6.2.1 Reading fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 6.2.1 Reading fluency, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read a text fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 6.2.1 Reading fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: The learner ensures access to appropriate resources as they listen to audiobooks and work with others to identify

features of expressive reading such as pitch, pace and volume.

73

Values:
Integrity: The learner will practice honesty as they work in pairs to identify examples of expressive reading.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Life Skills Education-peer pressure resistance: The learner’s ability to cope with peer pressure is enhanced as they record the

readings and share them with others online.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print texts

● Braille texts

● Electronic reading materials

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Audio visual clips

Suggested Skills:

● Describing the features of expressive reading from a selected text,

● Reading a text at the right speed and accurately for fluency,

● Reading a text with expression to bring out pitch, pace, volume and intonation patterns,
